text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — auth verification errors spike (Okta). Alerting on-call. https://redwood.incidents/p/2478103333
alice: seeing huge 504/502 from okta-introspect EU region, pages starting ~12:03 UTC. console logins failing for some tenants.
raj: can you paste the example logs?
alice: logs: `error: upstream response 504 from https://introspect.okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect (timeout)` repeated. Also `x-forwarded-for` shows same edge pool.
maria: Customer impact — two customers reported admin console lockouts; support tickets #5234 #5235. Frontend shows "unable to verify session" error.
dan: checked our auth-proxy metrics, 5xx to Okta from our proxies spiked 85% in last 3m. No other upstreams. DNS lookups for okta domains look normal.
sophia: any known Okta status?
okta-status: Okta incident posted: "We are experiencing elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses from the Introspect endpoint in EU-WEST-1. Working on a fix." https://status.okta.com/incidents/xyz
alice: timeline: 12:02 first spike, 12:05 ramped, 12:10 peak. console login error rate ~12% (from 0.3% baseline).
raj: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) enable local JWT session cache fallback for non-critical endpoints; 2) route introspect traffic to secondary Okta org region if available; 3) increase retry/backoff with jitter.
alice: trying local cache toggle on auth-proxy now (`/admin/feature-flags local_session_fallback=on`). Will monitor.
dan: note: cache fallback will let existing sessions through but won't help new sign-ins. Might reduce console impact while Okta recovers.
maria: can we triage which customers affected? I can message the two paying customers and offer status updates.
sophia: escalate to SEs for any affected large customers. Keep CSMs in loop.
oncall-rotation-bot: Paging raj (eng-sre) for P1 handoff — you are now on-call for incidents in #incidents.
raj: on it. Taking lead. Assigning tasks: alice — continue monitoring cache flip and metrics; dan — prepare proxy route change runbook in case we need to fail over to secondary; maria — gather affected tenant list and open customer comms; sophia — coordinate SE/CS escalation.
alice: cache fallback is ON. 1m after flip: auth-proxy 5xx to Okta down ~40%, console error rate down to 6%.
dan: prepping routing change: we have secondary Okta base URL `https://introspect-eu2.okta.com`. Need to validate CA certs and token scopes before failover. Running smoke curl now.
raj: can we increase retry window to tolerate transient 5xx? Update `auth-proxy` config to `retries=3, backoff_ms=300, jitter=true` for introspect calls?
dan: patching config now, will roll to a small canary.
maria: support: informing affected tenants — sending note that we're actively mitigating and that login stability is improving.
sophia: set status page draft: "Investigating intermittent auth verification errors affecting logins in EU region. Mitigation in progress."
raj: visibility: add a trace span in our logs for `introspect.fallback_used=true` so we can quantify how much traffic is served by fallback.
alice: added flag. Early numbers: 18% of introspects are served from local cache after flip. That aligns with drop in errors.
okta-status: Update: Okta identified degraded backend pool; mitigation deployed, some regions recovering.
raj: plan for next 30m: 1) monitor Okta recovery signals 2) keep cache fallback for 1 hour minimum 3) if Okta not stable, orchestrate region failover to `introspect-eu2` with a config rollout and short TTL on sessions 4) post-incident follow-up with metrics and RCA.
dan: ready the playbook for failover. I'll validate certs and create the canary config patch: 
```
route {
  match: "introspect.okta.com"
  upstreams: ["introspect-eu2.okta.com","introspect.okta.com"]
  health_check: true
}
```
alice: we should also create a temporary customer-facing blurb explaining why some consoles were inaccessible and what we did. maria, want to draft?
maria: drafting now. Will add timeline, mitigation steps, and ETA for RCA.
sophia: good. keep exec on the loop if any high-value tenant reports continued issues.
raj: mark this thread for postmortem. Tagging owners: `alice`, `dan`, `maria`. We'll run RCA tomorrow 1500 UTC.
alice: taking note. current status: Okta improving, console errors at 2.1% now. Keeping cache fallback on.
incident-bot: Incident P1 still open — severity lowered to P2 for monitoring phase. Updates: https://redwood.incidents/p/2478103333/updates
raj: handing off to alice for monitoring for the next 30m. I'll stay available. If we see regression, page the on-call again.
alice: ack.
maria: support will keep customers updated. closing comms after RCA draft. :thumbsup:
